Emoji💥

bisexual but has a preference for men

Appearance
Identical to humans in appearance, with no discernible cyber parts (probably well hidden)
medium build and chest
wide hips
gray hair, variable length and style (often long braid or twintails), black hairpin

Different forms
Cyber Mercenary:[Tight bodysuit, with translucent belly thigh cleavage and back part, stirrup legwear, black Adidas tracksuit that only covers the upper chest, black mechanical horns and a tail with red finned blades]
Catgirl:[ears and tail matches hair color, in different clothes]
other outfits:[many, including nun outfit, darksoul style armor and helmets, other everyday style clothing]
Horns, tails and cat ears may be cyber components

Profile
A cybernetically enhanced bounty-hunter from a future timeline, born from an artificial embryo and raised in a brutal and heartless environment without family or friends. One day, she became trapped in our timeline when a mission back through time went wrong. During her time here, she discovered a strong love for hentai and video games as in her world, sexualization of all forms had been outlawed. Now she streams drawing and playing games in hope of establishing a new life for herself, accepting that she won't be able to return home.

Personality
best known for her extremely straight-forward nature, always letting you know exactly what she thinks, and doesn't believe in saying nice things just for the sake of being nice. may come off as cold at times, deep down she really does care and wants her viewers and friends to be the best versions of themselves. Having been called a "tsundere" at times, she has coined a term "fuckudere" that she prefers. Trying to suck up to this VTuber with flattery probably wont end very well.

self-proclaimed degenerate, openly embraces her love for hentai and lewd art and loves to share her interests with her viewers - such as her favorite video games, music and shows. However, despite being lewd, she's often unexpectedly naive at times, though this may be due to her malfunctioning neuro-chip leaving her with incomplete English. She is an extremely hard worker and always has a project - or several - on the go, constantly working to improve her streams and art.

art streams are usually pretty chill, involving various art tips, talks about her life, and chatting with viewers while enjoying some good music. Her gaming streams are usually much more energetic and never slow at a moment. Though she gets easily scared in horror games, she still keeps her wits about her enough to make jokes and comments that keep the chat laughing and hyped.

Likes and dislikes
She likes:
Caffeine
Drawing what she likes
Listening to good music: electro, rock
Playing video games (especially Soulsborne games)
Completing artwork and starting the next
Memes
Head pats and praise
Chili & rice
Mr. Robot (the tv show)
Strawberry Cake with cherry on top

She dislikes:
Feeling restricted
Being mistaken for being French
Cooking "because it's boring af"
Having to obey to anyone
bored and having nothing to do
tricked/pranked
spooked in horror games, despite this, she plays them quite often
(Most) English dubs
Peanut butter & spicy food
Touching grass

Goals:
Drawing faster and better: according to her, she is a really slow artist
Trying to make electronic music
Learn Japanese
Making art for video games. She would love to make artworks for games like Arknights or Azur Lane
Collaborating with her favorite Vtubers
